Rippling.note: Auto-detection flagged this as Ashby, but Rippling hosts careers on their own Next.js page.

Hex.note: Auto-detection flagged this as Ashby, but Hex uses a Gatsby-built careers site.

Loom.note: Loom was acquired by Atlassian in 2023. No separate job board exists — check atlassian.com/careers if interested.

Retool.note: Retool's careers page loads jobs via JavaScript only. Manual check required.

Okta / Auth0.note: Okta acquired Auth0 in 2021. All jobs are now on Okta's Greenhouse board.

Boomi.note: Boomi uses Greenhouse but their slug is 'boomilp' (not 'boomi').

Chargebee.note: Chargebee hosts jobs on a custom subdomain (jobs.chargebee.com). Requires manual check or Firecrawl.

Freshdesk.note: Freshdesk is a product by Freshworks. All hiring is via SmartRecruiters at careers.smartrecruiters.com/freshworks.

Jotform.note: Jotform hosts their own careers page with JavaScript-rendered listings. Requires manual check.

BrowserStack.note: BrowserStack uses Workday. URL updated from their main site to the actual Workday job board.

Zoho.note: Zoho uses their own ZohoRecruit platform. Requires manual check.

SailPoint.note: SailPoint uses Workday. URL is the direct Workday job board.

DocuSign.note: DocuSign hosts jobs on their own careers site. Requires manual check.

InVideo.note: InVideo's careers page loads jobs via JavaScript only. Requires manual check.

Shopify.note: Shopify uses a custom careers portal. Requires manual check.

Hasura.note: Hasura (now PromptQL) uses their own careers page. EXA previously returned wrong URLs (Supabase's Ashby board) for this company.
